title: CreatePipelineRequest
description: POST /api/pipelines. `steps`/`outputs` (HEL-906 task 3.1) are additive -- absent or empty preserves the pre-existing simple create (name + sourceDataSourceId only). Non-empty `steps`/`outputs` builds the pipeline, its steps, and its Outputs in one call; any failure rolls back the whole call (see CreatePipelineTransactionalStepRequest's description).
